card.name: Embolism and fluid overload word parts
card.fires_on: Partway through words for embolism (emb, ol) and fluid overload (overloading), and on 'fill' in filling the bladder. It fires in warnings about fluid, air or fat entering the body.

modes.label: Embolism word parts
modes.description: The middle pieces of 'embolism' or 'embolus' after a material such as amniotic fluid, air, fat or barium.
modes.example: To reduce the risk of air<< emb>>olism, adhere to the preparation instructions

modes.label: Overloading
modes.description: The piece 'loading' ending 'overloading' after fluid and/or solute.
modes.example: Fluid Overload : Avoid in patients with or at risk for fluid and/or solute over<<loading>>. If use cannot be avoided, monitor

modes.label: Fill the bladder
modes.description: The verb 'fill' in contrast-medium instructions about filling an organ.
modes.example: Sufficient volume of contrast medium is administered to adequately<< fill>> the urinary bladder.

card.plain: It marks the middle of words like embolism and overloading, where the word is still unfinished.
